newsitem.title: UK: Sterling/mark hovers below highs, focus on budget.
newsitem.headline: Sterling/mark hovers below highs, focus on budget.

text.p: 0655 GMT - Stg/mark trading a quarter-pfennig below 59-month high of 2.8945 marks set earlier. Cable steady off overnight highs, $1.6600/10 seen as next support.
* Stg/mark at 2.8924/35 vs 2.8897/02 late Friday in Europe. Cable at $1.6625/36 vs $1.6614/24 Friday.
* UK budget Wednesday expected to move to curb consumer spending. Brown seen cutting tax break on mortgage interest payments (MIRAS) to 10 pct from 15 pct, according to Sunday newspapers.
* May UK consumer credit out at 0730 GMT. Provisional June M0 numbers and final May M4 and M4 lending data out at 0830 GMT.
